articles.title: Jupiter: The King of Planets and Its Wild Court of Moons
articles.summary: Jupiter is a colossal gas giant that could hold 1,300 Earths. With a centuries-old storm, volcanic moons, and possible alien oceans, it's a solar system within a solar system.

articles.title: Australia: A Continent of Extremes, from Deadly Snakes to Sacred Rocks
articles.summary: Australia is the only country that spans an entire continent. It boasts unique wildlife, the world's largest rock, and a vibrant multicultural society, but also some of the deadliest creatures on Earth.

articles.title: How Earth, Wind & Fire's Cosmic Vision Redefined Music
articles.summary: A new HBO documentary explores Earth, Wind & Fire's genre-blending sound and their founder's mission to create universal music. The film traces their breakthrough, breakup, and enduring legacy.
